title: About Us
seo_title: About Us & Editorial Team — Dream Home Decor
seo_description: Meet Claire Vance, Founder & Lead Interior Stylist at Dream Home Decor, and learn how we curate cozy living room and home styling guides.
content:
FOUNDER & LEAD INTERIOR STYLIST

Meet Claire Vance

Based in Austin, Texas, Claire Vance founded Dream Home Decor (dreamhomedecor.net) to help everyday homeowners and apartment renters create warm, livable, and timeless interiors without hiring a five-figure design firm.

Our Design Philosophy

At Dream Home Decor, we believe a great home should feel collected, comfortable, and deeply personal—never like a cold furniture showroom. Whether you are styling a small apartment living room, refreshing a primary bedroom with layered linen textures, or planning a warm spa-inspired bathroom remodel, our room-by-room guides break down exact color palettes, furniture proportions, lighting layers, and budget-friendly swaps.

What We Cover

  • Cozy Living Room Layouts & Styling: Sofa placement, rug sizing rules, warm wood tones, accent walls, lighting layers, and coffee table styling.
  • Restful Bedrooms & Boho Sanctuaries: Earthy neutral paint colors, organic bedding layers, small bedroom storage, and calming focal walls.
  • Spa Bathrooms & Smart Makeovers: Vanity lighting, tile pairings, warm brass hardware, and small bathroom layout ideas.
  • Seasonal & Whole-Home Decor: Entryways, ceiling details, holiday mantels, and timeless architectural touches.

Get in Touch

Have a design question, feedback on one of our guides, or a press/partnership inquiry? Visit our Contact Us page to send a message directly to our editorial desk.

content:
Last Updated: July 2026

Welcome to Dream Home Decor (accessible at https://dreamhomedecor.net). Your privacy matters to us, and this Privacy Policy explains in plain language what information we collect when you visit our website, why we collect it, how we use it, and the choices you have. By using Dream Home Decor, you agree to the practices described on this page. If you do not agree with any part of this policy, we kindly ask that you discontinue use of the site.

Dream Home Decor is a home and interior design publication that shares decorating ideas, room styling guides, furniture inspiration, seasonal decor tips, and product roundups. We are committed to being transparent about our data practices and keeping the personal information of our readers safe.

Who We Are

Dream Home Decor is an independent online publication focused on interior styling and home improvement content. Throughout this document, the terms “we,” “us,” and “our” refer to Dream Home Decor and its operators. The terms “you,” “your,” and “visitor” refer to any individual who accesses or reads content on our website.

The Information We Collect

We collect information in two broad ways: information you choose to give us directly, and information that is gathered automatically as you browse the site.

Information You Provide Voluntarily

There are situations where you may share personal details with us of your own accord. These include:

  • Contact submissions: When you reach out through our contact form or by email, we receive your name, email address, and the content of your message so we can reply.
  • Comments: If you leave a comment on an article, we store the name, email address, and comment text you submit, along with your IP address and browser details to help us prevent spam.
  • Newsletter sign-ups: Should we offer an email subscription, we retain the email address you provide so we can send you updates. You may unsubscribe at any time.

Information Collected Automatically

Like almost every modern website, Dream Home Decor and its service providers automatically log certain technical data whenever you visit. This may include:

  • Your Internet Protocol (IP) address
  • Browser type and version
  • Operating system and device type
  • The pages you view and the time spent on each
  • The website or search engine that referred you to us
  • General geographic location inferred from your IP address (typically country or region level)
  • Date and time stamps of your visit

This information is aggregated and statistical in nature. We use it to understand which articles resonate with readers, to diagnose technical problems, and to improve the overall browsing experience.

Cookies and Similar Technologies

Cookies are small text files placed on your device that allow a website to recognize your browser and remember certain preferences. Dream Home Decor uses cookies and comparable technologies for several purposes:

  • Essential cookies that keep the site functioning correctly.
  • Preference cookies that remember choices such as your region or display settings.
  • Analytics cookies that help us measure traffic and understand reader behavior in aggregate.
  • Advertising cookies served by our advertising partners to display relevant ads and limit how often you see the same advertisement.

You are always in control of cookies. Most web browsers let you refuse cookies, delete existing ones, or notify you before a cookie is stored. Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect how parts of the site work for you.

Google AdSense and Third-Party Advertising

Dream Home Decor is supported by advertising, which allows us to keep our content free for readers. We use third-party advertising companies, including Google AdSense, to serve ads when you visit our website.

Here is what you should know about how these advertising partners operate:

  • Google, as a third-party vendor, uses cookies to serve ads on Dream Home Decor.
  • Google’s use of advertising cookies (including the DoubleClick DART cookie and other advertising identifiers) enables it and its partners to serve ads to you based on your visits to this site and other sites across the internet.
  • Third-party vendors and ad networks may also use cookies, web beacons, or similar technologies to collect non-personally identifiable information for the purpose of showing advertisements likely to be of interest to you.
  • These advertising cookies may collect data such as your IP address, browser type, pages viewed, and the time and date of your visit.

You have meaningful choices about personalized advertising:

  • You may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings.
  • You can opt out of a third-party vendor’s use of cookies for personalized advertising by visiting www.aboutads.info.
  • For more information on how Google uses data when you use our partners’ sites or apps, please review Google’s own policy at policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites.

Dream Home Decor has no access to or control over the cookies used by third-party advertisers. This Privacy Policy does not apply to, and we cannot be responsible for, the privacy practices of those third parties. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of any advertiser or external service you interact with.

Analytics Services

We may use analytics tools such as Google Analytics to help us understand how visitors use our site. These tools collect information sent by your browser as part of a web page request, including cookies and your IP address. The data helps us evaluate content performance and improve our publication. Google Analytics data is processed in a way that does not personally identify individual readers. You can learn more about Google’s practices at policies.google.com/privacy, and you may install the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on if you prefer not to be tracked.

How We Use Your Information

The information we collect is used strictly for legitimate purposes, including to:

  • Operate, maintain, and improve the Dream Home Decor website
  • Respond to your questions, comments, and requests
  • Deliver and measure the effectiveness of advertising
  • Analyze usage trends so we can create better content
  • Detect, prevent, and address technical issues, fraud, or abuse
  • Send newsletters or updates where you have opted in

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties for their own marketing purposes.

Data Retention

We keep personal information only for as long as it is needed to fulfil the purposes described in this policy or as required by applicable law. For example, comment data remains stored so that follow-up replies display correctly, and contact form messages are retained for as long as necessary to resolve your inquiry. When information is no longer needed, we take reasonable steps to delete or anonymize it.

Your Privacy Rights

Depending on where you live, you may have specific rights regarding your personal data. These can include the right to:

  • Request access to the personal information we hold about you
  • Request correction of inaccurate information
  • Request deletion of your personal data
  • Object to or restrict certain processing of your data
  • Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent

For Visitors in the European Economic Area (GDPR)

If you are located in the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom, you are protected under the General Data Protection Regulation. We process your data on the lawful bases of consent, legitimate interest, or legal obligation, depending on the context. You may exercise any of the rights listed above by contacting us.

For Visitors in California (CCPA)

California residents have the right to know what personal information is collected, to request deletion, and to opt out of the sale of personal information. Dream Home Decor does not sell personal information as defined by the California Consumer Privacy Act. You may submit a request by contacting us using the details below.

To exercise any privacy right, please email us and we will respond within a reasonable timeframe, subject to identity verification where necessary.

Children’s Privacy

Dream Home Decor is intended for a general adult audience interested in home and interior design. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under the age of 13 (or the equivalent minimum age in your jurisdiction). If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us and we will promptly delete it.

External Links

Our articles sometimes link to third-party websites, product retailers, or resources that we believe our readers will find helpful. Once you leave Dream Home Decor, this Privacy Policy no longer applies. We are not responsible for the content or privacy practices of any external site, and we recommend reviewing the privacy policy of every website you visit.

Data Security

We implement reasonable technical and organizational safeguards designed to protect the information under our control against loss, misuse, and unauthorized access. However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is completely secure. While we strive to protect your data, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, technology, legal requirements, or for other operational reasons. When we make material changes, we will revise the “Last Updated” date at the top of this page. We encourage you to review this page periodically so you stay informed about how we protect your information. Your continued use of the site after any changes indicates your acceptance of the revised policy.

Contact Us

If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or how your data is handled, please get in touch:

  • Website: https://dreamhomedecor.net
  • Email: techybadshah14@gmail.com

We will do our best to address your inquiry promptly and thoroughly.

Hi there! I’m a bike messenger by day, aspiring actor by night, and this is my website. I live in Los Angeles, have a great dog named Jack, and I like piña coladas. (And gettin’ caught in the rain.)

…or something like this:

The XYZ Doohickey Company was founded in 1971, and has been providing quality doohickeys to the public ever since. Located in Gotham City, XYZ employs over 2,000 people and does all kinds of awesome things for the Gotham community.

As a new WordPress user, you should go to your dashboard to delete this page and create new pages for your content. Have fun!
